import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source data
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/test_1.csv"
    target_output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: Student-level data
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Expected columns: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score']

    # Load Source 1: School-level data
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Expected columns: ['School ID', 'school_name', 'type', 'size', 'budget']

    # Merge student data with school data on 'school_name'
    # This will add 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget' columns to each student record
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on='school_name', how='left')

    # Check for any students with missing school info after merge (optional)
    missing_school_info = df_merged[df_merged['School ID'].isna()]
    if not missing_school_info.empty:
        print("Warning: Some students have no matching school info. They will have NaNs in school-related fields.")

    # Ensure correct data types according to target schema:
    # Target Schema: 
    # ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str, 'school_name': str,
    #  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]

    # Convert columns to appropriate types
    df_merged['Student ID'] = df_merged['Student ID'].astype(int)
    df_merged['student_name'] = df_merged['student_name'].astype(str)
    df_merged['gender'] = df_merged['gender'].astype(str)
    df_merged['grade'] = df_merged['grade'].astype(str)
    df_merged['school_name'] = df_merged['school_name'].astype(str)
    df_merged['reading_score'] = df_merged['reading_score'].astype(int)
    df_merged['math_score'] = df_merged['math_score'].astype(int)

    # For school-related columns, some may have missing values if merge failed, fill or convert carefully
    # Fill missing numeric school fields with 0 or appropriate default
    df_merged['School ID'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['School ID'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['type'] = df_merged['type'].fillna('Unknown').astype(str)
    df_merged['size'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['size'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['budget'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['budget'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
                      'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    df_target.to_csv(target_output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
